upgrade1029ConflictsE.mentionAlwaysAllowed: Authorized people can always @mention this bot.
upgrade1029ConflictsE.runAutomaticallyDescription: Start work without a mention when an allowed person creates an issue or updates a pull request.
upgrade1029ConflictsE.automaticRunsHelp: Runs for authorized authors in Access. Use the author filters below to limit whose issues and PRs start work.
upgrade1029ConflictsE.includeBotAuthorsHelp: The account also needs a sponsor and external-contributor automatic runs enabled in Access.
upgrade1029ConflictsE.includedAuthorsHelp: Leave empty for all authorized authors. One username or glob per line.
upgrade1029ConflictsE.targetBranchesHelp: Leave empty for all branches. Supports * and **.
upgrade1029ConflictsE.filtersBypassedByMention: Reviews requested by @mention bypass these scheduling filters. Repository access and ignored files still apply.
upgrade1029ConflictsE.ignoredFilesHelp: Excluded from all reviews, including @mentions. One pattern per line; supports * and **.
upgrade1029ConflictsE.hiddenFindingsStillCount: Hidden findings still count in the assessment.
upgrade1029ConflictsE.approvalsIntro: Optional formal decisions on GitHub. Scores, comments, and checks still work when these are off.
upgrade1029ConflictsE.allowApprovalsHelp: Lets the agent submit an Approve review on GitHub after a complete assessment. The agent must explicitly choose it; a 5/5 score or passing check does not approve the PR. Off still allows scores, comments, and checks.
upgrade1029ConflictsE.allowRequestChangesHelp: Lets the agent submit a Request changes review on GitHub after a complete assessment. This is a formal review decision and may prevent merging under your repository rules. Off still allows findings, comments, and a failing check.

upgrade1029ConflictsE.onlyEnabledMembersCanMention: Only members you enable below can mention this bot.
upgrade1029ConflictsE.noMembersLinked: No members linked yet. Link an account to get started.

upgrade1029ConflictsE.allowAutomaticRunsForExternal: Allow automatic runs for external contributors
upgrade1029ConflictsE.externalAutomaticRunsOn: Authorized contributors can trigger the events and author filters configured in Settings.

upgrade1029ConflictsE.responsibleMemberHelp: The member accountable for automatically created Paperclip tasks. GitHub authors remain recorded separately. This grants no access to the member’s personal credentials.

upgrade1029ConflictsE.outgoingCallsHelp: Outgoing calls use your saved callback number and opt-in. For a private incoming call, enter the code spoken on the phone in signed-in Paperclip and select a task to approve that live call. Incoming calls can start a new conversation task without sign-in, under a task-scoped low-trust policy. Private mode is optional and requires approval before accessing existing tasks.
